five_day_thesis: The regime changed on 2026-08-31 — the true gamma flip migrated $4,510 → $4,600 (+$90) while spot fell through it, moving GC from long-gamma stabilization at $4,693.8 to short-gamma amplification at $4,481.0, a $212.8 (-4.53%) five-session decline. Window net GEX collapsed 899.4 → 543.3 (-39.6%), so the dealer cushion that damped the first three sessions is now barely a third of its prior size. Positioning turned with it: put OI within $500 below spot built 17,767 → 25,242 (+42.1%), while the $8,000 call wall was unwound 27,036 → 21,013 (-6,023, -22.3%) in the single 8/31 session. The tell is that ATM IV compressed 25.13% → 22.69% (-2.44pp) through a 4.5% selloff — vol supply into a decline marks orderly, pre-hedged repositioning rather than liquidation panic. Max pain drifted only $6,000 → $5,900 (-$100) against a $212.8 spot drop, confirming the pain surface is anchored to legacy OI and is not tracking this market.
